It has been a long time since I read the books, and the show hasn't given much reason to theorize this, but if memory serves me correct there are a few reasons. I recall that in the books, Azor Ahai would wield Lightbringer, a sword that gives of light and heat.Stannis draws his blade within the presence of Maester Aemon and (I think) Samwell, the blade gives of a glimmering light, Aemon asks Sam if it gives off light, Sam concedes that it does but Aemon mentions he feels no warmth, and therefore the sword is not Lightbringer. 

 Neds sword was smelted down into two blades, one Joffrey got, he dubbed it Widows Wail (He was a cunt wasn't he?) and the other Jaime received, Oathkeeper, which he gave to Brienne, whom I believe will die for Jamie and he'll reclaim the sword. The books speak of the prophecy more, and perhaps someone else can elaborate, but I believe part of Jamies arc falls in line with a line of the prophecy. Not to mention IMO Jamie has had the best arc in regards to character redemption and him being the PtwP would bring his arc full circle, where he will die to save Westeros, Dany will either die or become the Night Queen, and Jon will be the most just King to sit the iron throne in hundreds of years. 
 Of course this is all loose conjecture.

EDIT: Plunging the sword through the heart would also be a great way to kill off Cersei. Before his redemption,  he was Kingslayer, the man that pushed a child out the window, who assaulted honorable Ned. Becoming Queenslayer would bring him full circle, Cersei is irredeemable and it would be Jamie finally letting go of his biggest flaw, his sister, and drawing his sword from her heart, the woman he loved his entire life, he has fulfilled prophecy and became the PtwP.
